title: Carl Sagan: If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe.
summary: A very short clip of Carl Sagan saying that to make an apple pie from scratch you must first invent the universe. It illustrates how everything depends on a chain of prior things.
why: HN commenters use the quote as shorthand in arguments about abstractions, standing on others' work and the limits of building from scratch.

quote.text: It took a solid chunk of western civilization to make Uber possible.
